image_description: A coastal landscape featuring a prominent, dark sea stack (rock formation) rising from the ocean in the foreground. The rock is covered with patches of green vegetation on its ledges. The background shows a calm sea extending to the horizon under a cloudy sky with soft, warm lighting suggestive of sunset or sunrise.
